subject: Re: Request to reopen expired sandbox credits — HarborAI pilot
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@harborai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial sandbox credits expired — can we get a short extension?

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from our side — we were running a proof-of-concept last week and exhausted the sandbox credits overnight when a couple of experiments spiked. The account (HarborAI POC) shows the trial expired earlier today, and a few key evals are still pending.

Is there a path to reopen the sandbox for another 7–10 days or a small top-up while we finalize the procurement paperwork? We’re close to a technical decision and want to validate a KV-cache/latency regression before committing.

Attached: harborai_usage_snapshot.csv (shows token burn pattern).

Thanks,
Ethan
CTO, HarborAI
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@harborai.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial sandbox credits expired — can we get a short extension?

Thanks for the quick context, Ethan — appreciate the usage file.

We can do a short, one-off sandbox reactivation to let you run the KV-cache experiments. Two options that our team typically offers:

- Emergency 7-day top-up (small token allotment) — quick approvals, no paperwork needed.
- 14-day extension tied to a short mutual action plan (MVP checklist) and a soft-touch procurement acknowledgement — safer for longer evals.

If you want the 7-day option, I can issue it from my side this afternoon and loop in Finance for a follow-up note. If you opt for 14 days, please share a one-paragraph confirmation from procurement and I’ll route to Naomi for sign-off.

Which do you prefer?

—Kimberly
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Please include a one-line procurement ACK in the thread (simple yes from their procurement alias) before we finalize the PDF approval.

Attaching provisional approval: credit_extension_approval.pdf (internal).
